findings: S4 test (test_config_above_policy_fails_load_s4) at line 404 is a placeholder that passes without validation. It uses self.assertTrue(True, ...) instead of testing that config loading actually fails when a model exceeds the policy ceiling.
Two additional tests are placeholders: test_default_routing_table_exists (line 590) and test_project_can_override_routing_config (line 607) both pass without real assertions.

The routing.py implementation at line 71 defines validate_model_assignment() to enforce the policy ceiling, but this function is never called during config loading, so S4's requirement is not implemented despite having a passing test.

The test suite uses a mock executor (ROUTING_EXECUTOR) that simulates routing behavior rather than exercising the actual routing.py implementation. While this is an acceptable integration testing pattern, it means routing logic bugs would not be caught.
